about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). The tests run in fast-test's Nix container on The Beast, in the dev shell (tests/fast-test-container), and so does the flake's evaluation; only the linters' quick step runs on The Dragon. The VM tests a change touches run on The Beast with KVM (the vm-tests step, scripts/vm-test). The NixOS checks (every flake check, all the VM tests, the ISO) stay on the nixos.yml workflow on The Beast's runners: it runs for a release, started by hand on the release branch, and on the Nixpkgs and vendor update branches.

steps.name: regression
steps.about: The source and fixture regression suite, with the linters (tests/lint: Ruff, ShellCheck, actionlint). It runs for every change: its tests also read the docs, the workflows, the release notes and assets/scripts.

steps.name: shell
steps.about: QML lint and the shell's runtime tests (Settings, Software, Software Update, Welcome, shortcuts, wallpapers, displays, media, plugins), when the code they run changed. Each test's Quickshell has a home, runtime directory, session bus and compositor of its own, so the step runs beside the others and beside another run.

steps.name: assistant-overlay
steps.about: The real Cybex OS Assistant window and service in a private headless Sway, when the assistant changed.

steps.name: single-tests
steps.about: A changed standalone test script, one after the other. Each one's Quickshell has a home, runtime directory, session bus and compositor of its own, so the step runs beside the others and beside another run.
steps.run: tests/fast-test-container sh -c 'for f in "$@"; do python3 -B "$f" || exit 1; done' sh {files}

steps.name: lint
steps.about: A quick first run of the linters here, for the workflows and scripts; the regression step runs them too.

steps.name: vm-tests
steps.about: The NixOS VM tests a change touches: a changed test, the tests using a changed helper in nix/tests, and those scripts/vm-test ties to changed code (COVERS). They are built and run on The Beast with KVM; this step only waits for them.

steps.name: flake-check
steps.about: The flake evaluates, in fast-test's Nix container on The Beast (its copy there is one commit deep, so Nix is told that's fine).
